name: footer-section
title: App download footer
description: A dark rounded footer for app sites: a red download panel with App Store and Google Play badges and a diagram of the app as a hub with four feature nodes, light running the wires into it, then four link columns, a pinned post, the copyright and social links. Stays dark in light and dark mode.

useCases: Mobile app and music streaming websites
SaaS sites that end with an app download call
Product landing pages with store badges
Startup sites that need a full footer with socials
